$description: The vocabulary of ui-showcase-bento: one meaning per term, the identifiers each term owns (names) and the labels to keep out of prose (avoid). scripts/terms.mjs keeps it closed both ways against what the skill emits: every emitted name is listed here, and every listed name is emitted. Aliases may hold retired identifiers that are still accepted.
principles: This skill owns the showcase canvas: its frame, packing, page, switches and checks. Lengths belong to ui-geometry, colour to ui-colors and paint to ui-materials; a term owned there is related here, not redefined.
A public name (spec key, data attribute, CSS variable, axis id, flag, API) is never renamed without an alias.
Where a sibling skill uses the same word for something else, the concept's `not` says so.

concepts.definition: One page of labelled groups of specimens on a fixed canvas, built by scaffold.mjs from one or more sources and checked by uiBentoCheck.
concepts.intent: Show what a system, framework or brand can produce, all at once, at component scale.
concepts.not: Not a component library, an app or a jig for tuning constants (ui-kit-inspector), and not a comparison of implementation alternatives (component-variants).

concepts.definition: The fixed box, in px, that holds every tile: canvas.width × canvas.height, with the chrome margin inside it.
concepts.intent: One budget every arrangement must fit without scaling.
concepts.not: Not the page: the page also holds the bar and the side gutter outside the canvas.

concepts.definition: A group's region on the canvas: a heading and its specimens, at the chrome padding and radius. A group is the data; its tile is how it is drawn.
concepts.intent: Gather related specimens under one label and one minimum size.
concepts.not: Not a card component being shown: a tile is page chrome.

concepts.definition: One labelled entry inside a tile: a caption and a slot that holds the drawn pattern with all the states its brief requires.
concepts.intent: One pattern per entry, with states as variants inside it, never as extra specimens.
concepts.not: Not a live, operable component: specimens are static drawings.

concepts.definition: The visible name of a tile (its heading) or of a specimen (its caption), marked data-label.
concepts.intent: Every group and specimen is named, and the checker refuses one that is not.

concepts.definition: The box inside a specimen that holds its fragment; an unfilled slot shows the depiction as a placeholder.
concepts.intent: Let the scaffold lay out a sheet before any specimen is drawn.

concepts.definition: An element inside a specimen whose box the checker compares across axis values: data-part, or ui-materials' data-layer, data-relief and data-face.
concepts.intent: Prove that switching an invariant axis moves nothing.
concepts.not: Not ui-materials' anatomy itself: that skill defines layer, relief and face; this skill only reads them.

concepts.definition: data-inset on content that deliberately starts off its caption's left edge, so the edge check does not warn.
A specimen for a feature the source turned off, marked data-empty, saying which key turns it on.
concepts.intent: A feature that is off keeps its specimen.

concepts.definition: A JSON manifest saying what one system brings to a sheet: its brief, what it owns, its groups or catalogue, chrome, axes, token sources and acceptance items. Validated against the closed sets in lib.mjs.
concepts.intent: Keep each system's substance in its own brief and only the wiring here.
concepts.not: Not the system's brief: the brief stays in the system's own skill and wins on depictions.

concepts.definition: The source whose `owns` names a concern. Lengths: only its chrome lengths apply. Colors: only its chrome colours apply. Paint: informational, no chrome field.
concepts.intent: Let ui-geometry, ui-colors and ui-materials each win their own concern whatever the order.

concepts.definition: The source whose groups the sheet shows: the one named by --content, else the first with groups.
A source with no groups that sets the canvas, the areas and measured minimums for a content source's groups, such as layouts/aria-24-1280.json or layouts/geometry-28-1280.json.
concepts.intent: Reuse an arrangement that has passed the check.

concepts.definition: A shared set of groups and specimens in catalogues/*.json (aria-24, geometry-28, colour-24) that a source names with {"catalogue": id}. briefRow maps a specimen to its row in the brief when the names differ.
The arrangement: CSS grid-template-areas rows of group ids, '.' for an empty cell; every group a rectangle.
Sizing the column and row tracks so every group meets its minimum and the tracks close exactly on the canvas; NOFIT when no arrangement of these tracks fits.
concepts.intent: Fit by arrangement and measurement, never by scaling.

concepts.definition: The checker's measured size for each overflowing tile, { group: [w, h] }, fed back to pack with --mins.
The sheet's own lengths, type and colours: margin, gutter, tile padding and radius, gaps, title and caption sizes, font, header, and the colour map.
concepts.intent: Everything around the specimens, owned by the lengths and colours owners.
concepts.not: Not a specimen's paint: specimens take their paint from the material tokens.

concepts.definition: The ruling on every tile, from its content edge: minor lines every `grid` px, major every `gridMajor` cells, at gridStrength (light) or gridStrengthDark (the darkThemes values) per cent of the line colour.
concepts.intent: Give overlays something behind them and let a reader measure lengths against the ruling.
concepts.not: Not a per-specimen backdrop: no specimen draws its own.

concepts.definition: A switch in the page's bar that sets one attribute (or swaps one class) on a target, with a closed list of values, optional aliases for retired values, and optional captions naming the current value.
concepts.intent: Let one sheet show every mode, material and overlay, and let the checker compare them.

concepts.definition: An axis along which no box may move or resize (invariant: true, the default). Mode, material, anatomy and grid are invariant; density and size are not.
The switch between the colour system's modes (light, dark, dim). Its public id is `theme`; with ui-colors it swaps mode classes, otherwise it sets data-theme.
concepts.not: Not a theme in ui-colors' sense (a named request with all its modes), and not a mode in ui-materials' sense (the four paint settings).

concepts.definition: The switch between ui-materials' presets (flat, physical, frosted, glass, outline), setting data-material; each value's caption names its four settings.
The overlay that outlines every part by one ui-materials attribute: off, layer, relief or face, with a legend as its caption. `on` is the retired single overlay and maps to relief.
A source's `tokens`: the stylesheets to inline (css) and the commands that produce them (commands). The scaffold refuses a missing stylesheet and names its command.
concepts.not: Not a design token: the variables live inside those stylesheets and belong to their owning skill.

concepts.definition: check.js in the page: uiBentoCheck(opts) runs the layout, label, scale and invariance checks across every axis combination and returns { ok, errors, warnings, needs, summary }; uiBentoRects() dumps every box.
concepts.intent: Prove what the browser can prove; acceptance items it cannot prove are checked by eye and reported as such.
